seatAssignment: candidate is P1 in even-numbered games and P2 in odd-numbered games

strengthProbe.purpose: small feasibility comparison using the existing benchmark defaults; not a launch-strength estimate

policyValueProbe.purpose: policy-head top-choice play and one-sample network value signal on the same deterministic conditions

evidence.perGame: initial state, derived seed, moves, P1-perspective evaluations, outcome, termination reason, and legality errors
evidence.aggregate: W/L/D by candidate seat, legality, termination reasons, mean P1 evaluation, and mean absolute evaluation
evidence.trainingSignals: policy and value losses are read separately from the frozen training log
